lead.title: SBRI Healthcare opens round four of the NHS Cancer Programme call: up to £5M, closing December 1
lead.deck: Two routes: up to £3M over 24 months to deploy and evaluate a market-ready innovation (UK- or EU-based company, NHS partner and independent evaluator), or up to £5M for ICBs working with Cancer Alliances. Targeted examples include AI triage of urgent suspected-cancer referrals, decision support and ambient AI, interoperable with EPRs, the NHS App and the federated data platform.

milestone.title: Essex ICB plans to launch Doccla in respiratory services in its 2026/27 winter plan
milestone.summary: The winter plan counts 292 virtual ward and Hospital at Home beds, rising to 426 with other admission-avoidance capacity, and plans to extend ambient voice and remote monitoring. Doccla is to launch across respiratory services for virtual monitoring and admission avoidance.
milestone.why: Virtual beds are becoming a line item in a health system's winter plan, not a pilot. Meanwhile the NHS England board is worried about slow delivery of the federated data platform, the NHS App and ambient voice.

brefsEurope.title: NHS England sounds out the market for a national dataset on hospital medicines stock (£6.75M)
brefsEurope.summary: This is a pre-market engagement notice, not a contract: a reporting tool for hospitals, daily stock and issuance data, and a comparator of prices paid. Responses until November 1; contract envisaged April 1, 2027 to March 31, 2028, extendable.

word.full: Virtual Ward (hospital at home with remote monitoring)
word.definition: A service that follows patients at home, with sensors and a remote care team, who would otherwise occupy a hospital bed.

parts.label: Sensors
parts.role: the patient's vitals measured at home

how.t: The patient receives sensors (wearables) that transmit measurements.
Machine-learning models identify patients at risk of deterioration from clinical-grade sensor data.
The care team steps in to avoid admission or shorten the stay.

word.why: VC angle: a virtual bed is a budgeted line for health systems (Essex counts 292, 426 with other capacity). European players raise money to expand beyond the UK. Watch point: the lack of recurring national funding, which forces organizations to build it into their own budgets.

startups.name: Doccla
startups.use: Virtual ward and remote monitoring platform used by NHS trusts; £35M Series B led by Lakestar to expand in France and the DACH region

startups.name: Huma
startups.use: Remote monitoring platform deployed in many hospitals, including in the NHS; $80M Series D in 2024
